notes: TKBS Ideal Customer Profile — source of truth for Fit Score engine (Initiative 2). Keep weights and lists flexible; refine as real deals flow through. Any field marked 'matters: false' is ignored by the scoring engine.

target_industries.notes: Rough tags — real deal classification happens via normalized keywords matched against company industry + description.

revenue_range.notes: Below min = too small to afford TKBS. Above max = TKBS not the cheapest in their stack, and we avoid $50M+ corps entirely.

geographic_preference.notes: Nationwide service, local Michigan preferred for in-person opportunities.

years_in_business.notes: No sweet spot — new businesses and established ones both fit, as long as they match revenue + industry.

green_flags.label: Has a product or service but poor marketing presence
Looking to scale beyond strictly local reach
Needs basics TKBS provides easily (landing pages, email service, etc.)

red_flags.label: No clear idea what they want, expects everything at cheapest price
red_flags.notes: Cannot deliver full engineering strategy + run entire business for less than the Launch plan ($3k).

deal_threshold.notes: Any prospect unwilling to pay for at least a Launch plan is likely unqualified.

scoring_weights.notes: Must sum to 100. Tune as we learn what actually predicts closed_won.
